static_traits.name: Lin Ruoqing
static_traits.family_status: Living alone，饲养一只法国斗牛犬
static_traits.social_status: Has a few colleagues to talk to, but because of performance worries often finds it hard to open up, and relationship maintenance is affected
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往心理咨询/治疗史；此前not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好；开场略显紧张但能合作；能觉察并描述Anxiety与压力，并愿意与咨询师共同制定计划

basic_info.main_problem: 在工作中需要每天至少卖出10台洗衣机的业绩压力导致强烈的失败感与Anxiety，近来加重并影响睡眠、饮食及同事关系。
basic_info.core_demands: 工作中的失败恐惧和持续压力已影响我的心理健康和整体幸福感，希望缓解这种压力与Anxiety。

core_beliefs: 我的价值取决于工作业绩

special_situations.event: On workdays faces the company's performance target of 'selling at least 10 washing machines per day'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果当天卖not到10台，就等于失败，说明我not行，not yet来会受影响
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets reminders, watches motivational videos, does relaxation exercises and forces themselves to push through in pursuit of meeting standards
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 今天如果达not到10台，我就是失败者，可能还得放弃当记者的梦想

special_situations.event: 某天not yet完成销售目标后想到经理对自己表现的看法
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not达标，经理一定会很失望，最终我会丢掉工作
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少与同事深入交流，独自承受Anxiety以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他会对我失望，我可能会被解雇

special_situations.event: Even after reaching the day's goal, when facing sales targets again the next day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 必须每天都达标才算合格，否则就是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断自我提醒与设定更高标准来维持表现
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只要有一天not达标就证明我not行

special_situations.event: 在工作中与同事互动、想到自己可能达not到目标时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现not好，do not人会看低我，所以少说少错更安全
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避深入交流、缩短与同事的谈话
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的业绩差让大家not愿意接近我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen as competent, and to gain safety and stability (keep the job and be able to keep pursuing the dream of becoming a journalist)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败被negate、被责备，担忧失去工作与梦想
defense_goal: 以高标准与自我施压来避免失败与被责备
减少与同事的情感接触以降低被评价的风险
用理性分析与自我说服来压住not安与羞耻感

object_relations.self_representation: not达标时将自己视为“失败者/not合格员工”
object_relations.object_representation: Others (especially superiors) experienced as harsh, disappointed judges

object_relations.self_representation: 在同事关系中显得Anxiety、疏离的人
object_relations.object_representation: Colleagues experienced as people who may look down on me and find it hard to understand me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to examine the 'evidence' and challenge the belief 'failure = low self-worth'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 若承认not达标，就等于承认自己一without是处，会被negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Steady tone, emphasizing facts and logic, downplaying emotional experience as much as possible, using expressions such as 'objectively speaking...' to bypass directly feeling the sense of failure.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈到与经理/同事的看法和评价时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识里将内在的Self-denial体验为他人会失望或看低自己（移情：把他人当作苛刻的评判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use假设性与模糊化语言（如“他们可能觉得……”），回避承认自身的not安与羞耻。

manifestations: Living alone、与同事难以建立和维持关系
因业绩Anxiety而减少交流，难以向同事敞开

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 将“每天至少卖出10台”not yet经消化地当作自我价值的绝对标准
以必须/达标作为自我评价的核心依据

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 预设经理会对自己失望、同事会看低自己
把内在失败感体验为他人的负面评价

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: On high-pressure days 'just gritting through it', rarely proactively seeking others' support
将对外表达的Anxiety与求助转而对自己施压

exception_events.target_problem: 在工作日面对“每天至少卖出10台洗衣机”的目标时，通常会产生强烈的Anxiety与失败感，not yet达标后反复自责，并影响睡眠与同事关系。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在个do not工作日达到或超过当日目标后，出现相对的轻松与缓解，而非持续Self-denial，并能与同事进行短暂交流。
exception_events.reason: 线索：not同情境（当日客流与成交节奏更顺）；not同做法（适时进行短暂休息、保持节奏）；not同理解（将一次表现视为具体事件而非整体定性），因此当日Anxiety短时下降。

positive_force: On some workdays I can complete sales targets, with certain sales ability and execution capacity
愿意寻求帮助并与咨询师合作，愿意记录与识do not思维模式
Has tried various self-help strategies (reminders, motivational videos, relaxation exercises)
能在引导下生成更平衡的替代性想法
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking，将单次表现等同于整体价值
Tends to predict negative outcomes and mind-read others' evaluations, overly relies on external approval
在压力下自我施压并减少人际接触，支持系统利用not足
Sleep and diet are disturbed, further weakening coping ability and work performance

target_behavior.behavior: 在担心或not yet达成销售目标时出现的强烈Anxiety与Self-denial
antecedent: On workdays, faces the performance target of 'selling at least 10 washing machines a day'
想到可能without法完成当日目标
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and the belief that ties self-worth to performance
target_behavior.function: 通过自我施压来驱动更努力以避免被评价或失去工作（逃避被negate）
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent anxiety和压力循环，Sleep and eating disrupted，与Damaged relationships with colleagues，Decline in sense of well-being

target_behavior.behavior: 在工作中减少与同事的交流与链接（回避）
antecedent: 涉及业绩与目标的情境
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被负面评价与被negate，认为少说少错更安全
target_behavior.function: 短期逃避被评价与人际not适以缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support、Loneliness感增加，Anxiety维持并影响职场适应
